title: Why You'd Never Want To Meet An Orca

layers.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 10 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="100" stroke="#f3f6f7" stroke-width="5"/></svg>

scenes.notes: Wild killer whales could kill you easily. They never have.
Not because they can't. A big male is eight metres long, as heavy as four cars, and its fin alone is as tall as you.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 10 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="100" stroke="#f3f6f7" stroke-width="5"/></svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 600 40" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><line x1="10" y1="20" x2="590" y2="20" stroke="#f3f6f7" stroke-width="7" stroke-dasharray="26 18" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M 590 20 L 560 4 L 560 36 Z" fill="#f3f6f7"/></svg>

scenes.notes: It hits fifty-six kilometres an hour. An Olympic swimmer manages eight. You, maybe three. From fifty metres out, it reaches you in three seconds.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 10 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="100" stroke="#f3f6f7" stroke-width="5"/></svg>

scenes.notes: And you'd never meet just one. A pod hunts as a team, and you'd be outnumbered.

scenes.notes: In Antarctica, a pod charges an ice floe together, and the wave washes the seal straight off. You'd go too.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><radialGradient id="r"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ff5a4a" stop-opacity="0.85"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ff5a4a" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient></defs><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="100" fill="url(#r)"/></svg>

scenes.notes: Off South Africa, the shark you're scared of started washing up missing one organ. The liver. Orcas flipped them and took it.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 10 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="100" stroke="#f3f6f7" stroke-width="5"/></svg>

scenes.notes: The surviving great whites fled for months. If they run, what chance do you have?

layers.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 10 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="100" stroke="#f3f6f7" stroke-width="5"/></svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 40 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="20" y1="14" x2="20" y2="286" stroke="#f3f6f7" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="18 12"/><path d="M 4 26 L 20 2 L 36 26 Z" fill="#f3f6f7"/><path d="M 4 274 L 20 298 L 36 274 Z" fill="#f3f6f7"/></svg>

scenes.notes: In twenty nineteen, off Western Australia, a pod brought down the biggest animal on Earth. An adult blue whale, a thousand times your weight.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 10 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="100" stroke="#f3f6f7" stroke-width="5"/></svg>

scenes.notes: So why has something this fast and this smart never come for you?

layers.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 260 110" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="4" y="4" width="252" height="102" rx="51" fill="#f3f6f7" stroke="#0b1a22" stroke-width="6"/><path d="M 40 40 Q 70 56 100 40" stroke="#0b1a22" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M 56 50 Q 54 92 72 92 Q 90 92 86 50 Z" fill="#e5483d"/><text x="176" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, Arial Black, sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="44" fill="#0b1a22">YUCK?</text></svg>
<svg viewBox="0 0 10 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="100" stroke="#f3f6f7" stroke-width="5"/></svg>

scenes.notes: Maybe you taste bad? Nobody's ever proven that. Too small to bother with? You're about the size of the seals they eat.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 10 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="100" stroke="#f3f6f7" stroke-width="5"/></svg>

scenes.notes: The best answer is culture. Orcas eat what their mothers taught them. And no orca mother has ever taught her calf to eat you.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="90" fill="rgba(229,72,61,0.12)" stroke="#e5483d" stroke-width="7"/></svg>
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="90" fill="rgba(229,72,61,0.12)" stroke="#e5483d" stroke-width="7"/></svg>

scenes.notes: Comforting, right? Except since twenty twenty, orcas off Spain and Portugal have been ramming sailboats and snapping off their rudders.
About seven boats have sunk. Nobody knows why.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 10 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="100" stroke="#f3f6f7" stroke-width="5"/></svg>

scenes.notes: Maybe they just haven't decided about you yet. And that matters, because...
